You will work across diverse technology stacks (including C#, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, and SQL) to build, test, and deploy robust applications. A key differentiator for this role is the intentional use of AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding velocity and optimize software delivery across cloud ecosystems.

Application Deadline: October 11, 2026

CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes factors such as skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $50,000 - $80,000. This role is an existing vacancy.

Full-Stack Development: Build, maintain, and optimize responsive front-end interfaces (React, Angular) and reliable back-end systems (C#/.NET, Java/SpringBoot, Python).
AI Tool Integration: Actively utilize AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to write, debug, and refactor code efficiently.
Database Management: Write, optimize, and maintain efficient relational queries and data structures using SQL.
Automated Testing: Develop, maintain, and execute automated browser and end-to-end tests to ensure application quality.
Pipeline Management: Collaborate on configuring, maintaining, and automated testing via CI/CD coded pipelines.
Cloud & Infrastructure: Assist in deploying, monitoring, and managing multi-cloud application architectures, leveraging automation tools where applicable.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with data science teams to successfully integrate AI models and NLP data preprocessing pipelines into full-stack applications.

Technical Qualifications

Required qualifications to be successful in this role

Core Programming & Frameworks (Any or All)

Languages: JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C#, Java, and SQL.
Front-End: Modern JavaScript frameworks such as React or Angular.
Back-End: Frameworks like .NET, Node.js, or Java SpringBoot.

Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Familiarity with Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, or Cloud Run.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation (Strong Plus)

Configuration Management: Exposure to configuration management tools like Ansible.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Terraform and dry-run wrappers like Terragrunt.
System Imaging: Basic exposure to system imaging, container construction, or machine image bakery tools (e.g., Packer, Docker, or cloud-native image builders).

Version Control & CI/CD Pipelines

Source Control: Strong Git SCM skills, including branching strategies, pull requests, and code reviews.
Automation: Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and coded pipelines like GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, or AWS Code Pipeline.

AI & Data Science Integration (Preferred)

Model Understanding: Deep fundamental or hands-on understanding of AI model optimization, training, iterative testing, and performance validation.
Data Preprocessing: Awareness of preprocessing techniques for unstructured data utilizing Natural Language Processing (NLP).

Soft Skills & Professional Attributes

Continuous Learner: Highly adaptable mindset with a proven ability to pick up new programming languages, frameworks, and cloud services quickly.
Problem Solver: Analytical approach to troubleshooting application bugs and optimizing multi-cloud performance.
Communicator: Clear verbal and written skills to work effectively within an agile team environment.

jobs.description:
Solace helps companies connect and integrate all of their assets through the power of event-

driven architecture. Our technology makes it easy to unlock data silos and capture events

occurring across large enterprises; stream information about those events everywhere it needs

to be in real-time; and give the apps, AI agents and people who receive it the power to

immediately react with decisive actions and smart decisions.

Many of the world’s biggest companies trust Solace to modernize their IT infrastructure by

embracing trends like AI, cloud and IoT so they can create awesome experiences for their

customers, partners and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance

on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your

hard work!

About The Role

As a Junior Software Engineer on the Message Spool team, you will work with senior engineers

to build and improve the persistence layer of the Solace Event Broker. This system handles high

volumes of messages and guarantees delivery at scale.

We use AI coding tools like Claude Code every day. They help us build faster and keep our code

quality high. We care more about how you think and solve problems than about years of

experience. If you are quick to learn, comfortable with AI tools, and like figuring things out on

your own, this role is for you.

What You’ll Work On

You will help build new features for the message spool subsystem. You will work with:

Core Technologies: C and C++ on Linux, multithreading, and storage systems.
Development Tools: Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code review, and AI coding

assistants.

Learning Opportunities: performance analysis, debugging complex systems, and making

them more reliable and scalable.

You will use AI tools like Claude Code every day, to write code, test, and debug.

Key Requirements

AI aptitude: you are quick to learn and comfortable using AI tools like Claude Code, GitHub

Copilot, or Cursor to build, test, and debug. If you have not used these tools yet, you are excited

to start.

Independent problem solving: you can take a task, figure out an approach, and get unstuck

without much hand holding.

Culture fit: you care about craftsmanship, you are honest about what you know and do not

know, and you work well with a team.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical

Engineering, Computer Science, or a similar field.

Solid foundation in C or C++ and comfortable in a Linux environment.
Good written and verbal communication skills, for code reviews and working in an Agile team.

Preferred Qualifications

Nice to have, not required:

You have used AI tools to speed up learning or shipping work, in personal projects or a job.
Personal projects or open source work that show you can drive something on your own.
Modern C++ (C++11 and later) and the STL.
Multithreaded programming and a basic understanding of concurrency.
Debugging or profiling tools, like gdb, valgrind, or perf.
Familiarity with storage systems, databases, or file I/O.
Understanding of distributed systems or high availability.

What You’ll Learn

Production C and C++ systems: work on systems that run in production and handle real

customer traffic.

Storage and persistence: learn how we persist messages, optimize storage, and keep the system

reliable.

Modern development practices: learn AI-assisted development, CI/CD automation, and testing.
Distributed systems: get exposure to scalability, fault tolerance, and high availability.
Mentorship: work closely with senior engineers who will help you grow.

Why You’ll Love Working at Solace

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

Work with brilliance – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.
Balance matters – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.
Hybrid-first – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.
Values-driven – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom,

momentum, humility, and human experience.

Growth mindset – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.
Customer Obsessed – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).
Keep it fun – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.
Creative culture – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like

MITT and this (check them out!).

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening — including interviews and final hiring—

Role Status: EXISTING

This role is based in Montreal. At AlayaCare, our hybrid model includes 2 set in-office collaboration days/week, and it is expected that team members are present in the office on those days to foster connection, innovation, and teamwork.

Aperçu de l’entreprise

Connectez-vous à une carrière qui compte et aidez-nous à bâtir un avenir plus sûr.

Department Overview

Emergency Call Handling is the critical interface for the citizen into the command center, public safety workflow. We are the leading solution provider for Emergency Call Handling, the software that enables 911 call centers to receive and process calls in Public Safety Answering Points across North America. We are part of the Motorola Solutions Software Enterprise, where innovation of workflow enhancements are being developed for call handling, incident management, responder dispatching and situational awareness. This software developer position will be a member of the team working on software applications for Public Safety.

Présentation Du Département

La gestion des appels d'urgence est l'interface essentielle du citoyen avec le centre de commandement et le flux de travail de la sécurité publique. Nous sommes le principal fournisseur de solutions pour la gestion des appels d'urgence, le logiciel qui permet aux centres d'appels 911 de recevoir et de traiter les appels dans les centres d'appels de la sécurité publique (CASP) à travers l'Amérique du Nord. Nous faisons partie de la division Logiciels d'entreprise (Software Enterprise) de Motorola Solutions, où sont développées des innovations pour améliorer les flux de travail liés à la gestion des appels, à la gestion des incidents, à la répartition des intervenants et à la connaissance de la situation. Ce poste de développeur de logiciels fait partie de l'équipe travaillant sur des applications logicielles pour la sécurité publique.

Job Description

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join the team developing the VESTA 9-1-1 Call Handling solution. In this role, you will leverage agentic AI to build applications, automate DevOps and Cybersecurity workflows, improving quality and operational efficiency.

You’ll work alongside experienced engineers across real-time pipelines, telephony, backend infrastructure, and product surfaces. What You’ll Do

Develop Agentic AI-powered automation workflows to improve efficiency of our DevOps and Cybersecurity tasks.
Help integrate AI techniques to improve evaluation, testing, and observability for our systems.
Get your hands dirty setting up and configuring hardware and software, including network devices and servers.

Ask questions, dig into how things work, and bring fresh perspectives to the team.

You enjoy converting manual, tedious procedures to autonomous AI-powered workflows then jumping onto the next high-impact challenge.

You use AI tools daily, but you do not confuse speed with quality.

Real-time communication systems using WebRTC, WebSockets, RTP/SRTP, media streaming, or low-latency audio transport.
Exposure to DevOps, Automation and CI/CD systems using tools such as TeamCity, Jenkins, Github, Artifactory

Since being founded in Nanaimo in 2007, we have grown exponentially across North America, while maintaining our family-oriented, collaborative style of business.
Learn more about Alair at www.alairhomes.com

Job Description

This position is within the Technology department for Home Office.

This position is home based and will be interacting with a team spread across Canada and United States.

We are looking for a Test Automation Developer with strong Playwright and JavaScript/TypeScript skills to join the APEX Product Team. APEX is our internal platform: a React/TypeScript Single Page Application backed by PHP Laravel APIs that communicate with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. You will own and grow our automated test suite across the UI, Backend APIs, and the flow of data back into Business Central, so the team can ship quickly and with confidence.

This role is open to developers early in their career. If you have around two years of hands-on test automation with JavaScript/TypeScript and Playwright, we want to hear from you.

How We Work

We operate in a Product Operating Model: small empowered teams, outcome-focused goals, and continuous discovery. Quality is a shared responsibility. Developers write tests first on business logic and critical UI flows, and you partner with Developers and Product/Design to turn Acceptance Criteria into test cases, decide where each test belongs, and keep feedback loops fast.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain end-to-end test automation in Playwright across APEX modules, APIs, and Business Central integration points.
Take ownership of the existing automation: review it, refactor it, and remove flakiness and duplication.
Decide where coverage matters most using a risk-based approach, focusing on critical paths and high-impact areas.
Keep tests isolated with independent data per test and no cascading failures between apps.
Validating reported defects, and creating well-documented tickets that enable efficient debugging and resolution by development teams
Work with Developers on the handoff from Acceptance Criteria to test cases, and review test code in pull requests.
Integrate the suite into CI so it runs reliably, in parallel, and gives the team fast, trustworthy feedback.
Actively look for leverage: automation, reuse, modularity, documentation, self-serve tools.

Core Competencies and Required Skills and Experience

Test Automation (non-negotiable): Proven experience with test automation using JavaScript.
Playwright: Strong experience with locator-based (web-first) assertions and multi-project configurations.
JavaScript​: Comfortable writing it daily, and able to read and reason about both UI and API code.
API Testing: Solid experience testing REST APIs, ideally a Laravel backend. You call endpoints directly for setup and contract tests, and you know when the UI is actually the thing under test.
Risk-Based Coverage: You prioritize critical paths and high-impact areas rather than chasing coverage numbers.-
Test Design Judgment: You can explain the difference between types and benefits of different tests, and appropriateness for a situation.
Teamwork and Communication: Excellent collaboration and communication skills. Comfortable pairing with Developers, giving and receiving feedback in code review, and explaining quality risks to non-technical stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have Skills

TypeScript: Ability to read and reason about Types, Safety, and proper use.
Experience testing ERP or other stateful back-office systems, especially Business Central, including API-first setup (OData / custom API pages) and isolated test companies.
PHP / Laravel backend familiarity.
CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions or similar) and running tests in parallel.
Exposure to Product Management or Design practices.
Familiarity with the Construction industry, Franchise models, and Construction Project Management.
Interest in evaluating AI features (AI evals).

What Success Looks Like

30 Days:
Environment set up, pairing with the team to onboard, understanding domain basics, and a first review of the existing automation.
60 Days:
Contributing test code to the main branch regularly, with a clear plan for refactoring the existing suite.
90 Days:
One module fully covered by automated E2E tests (for example, the Invoices Module: Backend APIs and UI through to Business Central), and the existing automation refactored and cleaned up.
6 Months:
The APEX Product Team ships meaningfully faster because of reliable, trusted test automation.
1 Year+:
Helping define and build evaluation (AI evals) for AI features in our products.

$90,000 – $100,000 CAD per year

We are looking for a Test Automation Developer with strong Playwright and JavaScript/TypeScript skills to join the APEX Product Team. APEX is our internal platform: a React/TypeScript Single Page Application backed by PHP Laravel APIs that communicate with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. You will own and grow our automated test suite across the UI, Backend APIs, and the flow of data back into Business Central, so the team can ship quickly and with confidence.

This role is open to developers early in their career. If you have around two years of hands-on test automation with JavaScript/TypeScript and Playwright, we want to hear from you.

How We Work

We operate in a Product Operating Model: small empowered teams, outcome-focused goals, and continuous discovery. Quality is a shared responsibility. Developers write tests first on business logic and critical UI flows, and you partner with Developers and Product/Design to turn Acceptance Criteria into test cases, decide where each test belongs, and keep feedback loops fast.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain end-to-end test automation in Playwright across APEX modules, APIs, and Business Central integration points.
Take ownership of the existing automation: review it, refactor it, and remove flakiness and duplication.
Decide where coverage matters most using a risk-based approach, focusing on critical paths and high-impact areas.
Keep tests isolated with independent data per test and no cascading failures between apps.
Validating reported defects, and creating well-documented tickets that enable efficient debugging and resolution by development teams
Work with Developers on the handoff from Acceptance Criteria to test cases, and review test code in pull requests.
Integrate the suite into CI so it runs reliably, in parallel, and gives the team fast, trustworthy feedback.
Actively look for leverage: automation, reuse, modularity, documentation, self-serve tools.

Core Competencies and Required Skills and Experience

Test Automation (non-negotiable): Proven experience with test automation using JavaScript.
Playwright: Strong experience with locator-based (web-first) assertions and multi-project configurations.
JavaScript​: Comfortable writing it daily, and able to read and reason about both UI and API code.
API Testing: Solid experience testing REST APIs, ideally a Laravel backend. You call endpoints directly for setup and contract tests, and you know when the UI is actually the thing under test.
Risk-Based Coverage: You prioritize critical paths and high-impact areas rather than chasing coverage numbers.-
Test Design Judgment: You can explain the difference between types and benefits of different tests, and appropriateness for a situation.
Teamwork and Communication: Excellent collaboration and communication skills. Comfortable pairing with Developers, giving and receiving feedback in code review, and explaining quality risks to non-technical stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have Skills

TypeScript: Ability to read and reason about Types, Safety, and proper use.
Experience testing ERP or other stateful back-office systems, especially Business Central, including API-first setup (OData / custom API pages) and isolated test companies.
PHP / Laravel backend familiarity.
CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions or similar) and running tests in parallel.
Exposure to Product Management or Design practices.
Familiarity with the Construction industry, Franchise models, and Construction Project Management.
Interest in evaluating AI features (AI evals).

What Success Looks Like

30 Days:
Environment set up, pairing with the team to onboard, understanding domain basics, and a first review of the existing automation.
60 Days:
Contributing test code to the main branch regularly, with a clear plan for refactoring the existing suite.
90 Days:
One module fully covered by automated E2E tests (for example, the Invoices Module: Backend APIs and UI through to Business Central), and the existing automation refactored and cleaned up.
6 Months:
The APEX Product Team ships meaningfully faster because of reliable, trusted test automation.
1 Year+:
Helping define and build evaluation (AI evals) for AI features in our products.

Lighthouse Software Group is an operating group of Valsoft Corporation, a global acquirer and operator of vertical market software businesses. Valsoft acquires and builds mission-critical software companies serving highly specialized industries and holds them for the long term.

With 150+ companies and 4,000+ employees across 20+ countries, Valsoft’s decentralized model empowers businesses to operate independently while benefiting from operational best practices and long-term capital.

Lighthouse is responsible for sourcing, acquiring, and operating vertical market software companies globally. As we continue to grow, we are seeking driven individuals who want to join the team!

About The Role

We are looking for an AI-native full stack engineer to join one of the leading software companies within our portfolio.

Our platform powers mission-critical workflows for organizations that depend on it every day, and we are actively expanding it through AI capabilities and entirely new software products.

This role is designed for engineers early in their careers who want to build a lot, learn quickly, and take real ownership. You will work across both an established production platform and new AI-driven products.

We are especially interested in people who see themselves as builders. The best candidates are curious, ambitious, and constantly experimenting with new tools. They build side projects, explore AI models, and look for opportunities to improve systems rather than waiting for instructions.

You will work closely with a senior engineer who has built and scaled production systems and will provide direct mentorship as you grow. As the engineering team expands, there is also a clear leadership runway for someone who wants to take increasing ownership and eventually help lead the team.

This is a profitable, stable company with real customers and real infrastructure. The company operates within Lighthouse Software Group, part of Valsoft, a global group of vertical market software businesses with more than 130 companies and 4,000 employees across 20+ countries.

Roles & Responsibilities

You will work across three main areas of the product.

Core Platform Development (Approximately 25%)
Work within our existing production platform built primarily with PHP, Zend Framework, and JavaScript.
Responsibilities include:
Building and enhancing features within the existing platform
Debugging and resolving production issues
Refactoring legacy code to improve maintainability
Improving reliability, performance, and system quality
AI Feature Integration (Approximately 25%)
Help bring AI capabilities directly into the platform.
Responsibilities include:
Integrating LLM and AI APIs into product workflows
Building AI-powered tools and automation inside the platform
Identifying opportunities where AI can improve user workflows
Ensuring AI features are reliable and production-ready
Using AI development tools as part of your workflow is expected.
New Product Development (Approximately 50%)
Build new software products that expand the platform.
Responsibilities include:
Designing and developing new applications and product modules
Building production-ready systems rather than simple prototypes
Working across the product lifecycle from concept to deployment
Contributing ideas that shape future product direction
Much of this work will involve modern frontend development using React and related technologies.

Required Experience

2 to 4 years of professional software development experience
Experience building or contributing to production applications
Comfort working across frontend and backend development
Experience using or experimenting with AI APIs, LLMs, or AI development tools
Familiarity with modern development workflows and cloud-based tooling
We are particularly interested in candidates who demonstrate a builder mindset. Examples include side projects, experimentation with AI tools, open source work, or personal technical projects.

MHS is a leading developer of innovative solutions dedicated to measuring and developing the potential of people. We’re not just about assessments – we're about breaking barriers.

With over forty years of experience, we're pioneers in understanding and addressing neurological conditions and disorders–like ADHD in both children and adults. We're revolutionizing how gifted and talented youth are identified, ensuring a fair and inclusive process that nurtures potential in all its forms. We're deeply committed to improving outcomes within the justice system, offering support and resources to all involved. Our core values drive us to empower individuals at every level, focusing on talent development with an emphasis on emotional intelligence and leadership development.

We prioritize fairness, equity, and bias reduction in all aspects of our work while giving back to the communities we serve. Join us in our journey to create a world where everyone has the opportunity to succeed and thrive.

THE JOB

We are seeking a Low Code Engineer with strong computer science and cloud architecture expertise to help design, build, and evolve scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions across modern cloud and low code platforms. This role is ideal for an engineer who thinks like a software architect, understands how systems fit together end-to-end, and has experience bringing production-grade products to life using a mix of low code tools, traditional programming, and cloud services. While Microsoft Power Platform is an important part of our ecosystem, this is not a Power Platform–only role. We are looking for someone whose foundational engineering skills can be applied across any cloud or low code environment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

•
Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to translate business needs into well designed technical solutions.
• Design and build cloud-based, low code and hybrid solutions with a strong emphasis on architecture, scalability, security, and reliability.
• Apply software engineering best practices (version control, testing, CI/CD, documentation) in low code and cloud environments.
• Design and implement integrations using APIs, event-based patterns, and cloud services.
• Contribute to Azure-based solutions such as Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Web Apps, and related services.
• Participate in solution reviews, architectural discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Support production systems by diagnosing issues, implementing fixes, and improving long term solution quality.
• Contribute to AI-enabled workflows and solutions using platforms such as Copilot Studio, Agentforce, or similar AI/agent frameworks.
• Apply strong computer science fundamentals to low code and cloud solution design.
• Design technical architectures that balance speed of delivery with long-term maintainability.
• Build and extend low code applications that behave like real software products, not prototypes.
• Develop and integrate custom logic where low code tools reach their limits.
• Ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for security, performance, and observability.
• Work closely with stakeholders to clarify requirements and align solutions to business outcomes.
• Produce clear, accurate technical documentation throughout the delivery lifecycle.
• Share best practices and lessons learned with the broader engineering team.
• Demonstrates strong verbal communication skills, effectively conveying technical concepts to clients and internal stakeholders.

WHAT YOU BRING

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science or an equivalent discipline (required)
• Proven experience delivering production systems, not just proofs of concept
• Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• A product mindset: you care about reliability, usability, and long-term outcomes-term outcomes
• Curiosity, adaptability, and a desire to continuously grow your technical skill set

REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS

• Strong foundation in computer science, including software design, data structures, and system architecture
• Proficiency in Python (required) with the ability to write complex, production-quality logic
• Experience with C#, JavaScript, or similar languages is strongly preferred
• Solid understanding of cloud architecture concepts (compute, integration, identity, security, scalability)
• Hands-on experience working with APIs and system integrations
• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to building high quality solutions

PLATFORM & TECHNOLOGY EXPERIENCE

•
Experience building solutions in low code platforms, such as:
Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse)
Salesforce, Workday, or other enterprise low code environments

• Experience working in Microsoft Azure or comparable cloud platforms
• Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing
• Experience building or integrating AI-driven solutions (e.g., Copilot Studio, Agentforce) is a strong asset

Salary:
$60,000 - $75,000 per annum
